tools.name: agent-console
tools.description: Start, stop, restart or inspect the Agent Console server; restart-when-idle deploys after the last running thread finishes.

tools.name: claude-account
tools.description: Set up, log in or check one of the two isolated Claude accounts.

tools.name: github-triage
tools.description: Configure and run the GitHub issue triage service: sync, backfill, reconcile, calibrate.

tools.name: share-fetch
tools.description: Download a shared social media post (Instagram and similar) with its frames and metadata.

tools.name: instagram-fetch
tools.description: Wrapper over share-fetch that accepts only Instagram links.

tools.name: share-trace
tools.description: Trace what a share-fetch agent did, by agent id.

tools.name: transcript-redact
tools.description: Scan, remove or verify credentials in stored session transcripts, archives and derived SQLite caches. Preserves live login credentials; reports counts only.
